packageRules.description: dappertable is a runtime dependency, so it must cut a release. The shared python preset only puts pep621 and dockerfile updates under the dev- prefix, and this pin is tracked by the custom.regex manager below, so without this rule it lands on renovate/tnoff-dappertable-1.x and ci.yml's bump-version job (gated on renovate/dev-*) is skipped.

oke-scanner-core is a runtime dependency of scan, secret_age and ocir_cleanup, pinned to this repo's own core-vX.Y.Z tag tarball. Like dappertable it is tracked by custom.regex, which the shared python preset leaves unprefixed, so without this rule the update skips ci.yml's bump-version job (gated on renovate/dev-*) and the dependents never cut a release. All three pins share one depName, so they land in ONE PR and stay on the same tag, which tox needs (it installs all three in one env).

customManagers.description: Track the dappertable tarball pin (pep621 cannot version a plain archive URL)

Track the oke-scanner-core pin: this repo's own packages/core, installed from its core-vX.Y.Z tag tarball. extractVersion keeps only core-v* tags, so the old repo-wide v* tags and the other packages' <pkg>-v* tags are ignored.
